title: Family service - back to school - setting off together
description:
The family service is dedicated to the topic of starting school. The start of school life is an exciting time for children and parents alike. 
Older school children and teachers are also welcome.

description: You will need your own mat for your training. If you want, you can also bring a drinking bottle with you - we hope you have a lot of fun during your training.

title: Defeat the dragon
description:
The Sports and Recreation Commission and the YPS Club Swim Team need your help to conquer
of the dragon. Do you have the courage to take on the challenge?
Then come over and show the dragon how strong, brave and clever you are
are. There's a lot of fun waiting for you.

You don't need to register. Just grab your friends and

title: Brain fitness training
description:
Course leader:
Elke Nestler-Schreiber, synapse coach, brain fitness trainer
Cost per person:
CHF 19.- per hour for pensioners in the communities of Gamprin, Ruggell and Schellenberg. The course is financially supported by the three communities.
Registration and information:
Directly with the course leader, Tel. +41 79 450 21 92 or info(at)denkduenger.li. Trial lessons or entry is possible at any time. No previous knowledge is necessary. www.denkduenger.li.

title: Active together | An afternoon at the art museum
location:
Kunstmuseum Liechtenstein (Lageplan)
Städtle 32
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
to the exhibition Eleanor Antin. A retrospective
with Beate Frommelt

We take a close look at individual works of art in the current exhibitions and discuss them. Together with the artist Beate Frommelt, the participants then become active in the studio themselves. We try something different at every appointment.

No previous knowledge is required. Anyone and everyone is welcome! We are open to all ages from the age of 14 and up to a maximum of 10 people.

Beate Frommelt is experienced in working with young people, adults and people suffering from dementia.


time
2 p.m. to 4:30 p.m

As part of the free Wednesday, the offer is free of charge.


The events take place in collaboration with “Zemma tua – Seniors active together”. This program is coordinated by Dementia Liechtenstein.

The number of participants is limited, we ask you to register on +423 235 03 00 or directly via the website.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic «After Work Concert» Pure Percussion
description:
Pulsating rhythms, quick-witted virtuosity and sophisticated sounds: a concert for everyone who wants to leave everyday life behind them in a relaxed atmosphere after work.

Anyone who thinks of timpani and snare drums when they hear the term percussion will definitely be surprised this evening: the focus is on the marimba - an instrument with an expressive power that can best be described as voluminous resonance in all registers. At this after work concert, Christoph Sietzen and Bogdan Bacanu take the audience right into the heart of pulsating rhythms, quick-witted virtuosity and sophisticated sounds. The two artists have been making music together for many years. What they have in common is not only exceptional technical precision, but above all their playful lightness and great stage presence. “Pure Percussion” is a concert for the curious – for lovers of classical music as well as for everyone who wants to leave everyday life behind them in a relaxed atmosphere after work.

title: Festival Vaduz Classic “Night of the Opera” Nadine Sierra & Javier Camarena
location:
Generated BP name 1269721956120 (Lageplan)
Rathausplatz
9490 Vaduz
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
Take a seat, lean back and enjoy the most beautiful melodies of opera literature right in the heart of Liechtenstein.

On this summer evening, the Vaduz town hall square is transformed into an open-air opera stage - with a backdrop that no set designer in the world could create. Because as soon as the sun slowly disappears behind the mountains and the first notes sound, the music unfolds its very special magic. Two of the most important opera stars of our time contribute to this: the soprano Nadine Sierra and the tenor Javier Camarena, who delight audiences at the world's major opera houses. After joint successes in Verdi's "La traviata" and Gounod's "Roméo et Juliette", they can now be experienced for the first time at VADUZ CLASSIC and give us an unforgettable evening with arias and duets full of passion, virtuosity and emotions. Look forward to a concert that touches, thrills and resonates for a long time. And if you shed a tear or two of emotion, you're in good company.

For the 100th birthday of Mikis Theodorakis in 2025, the ensemble will play well-known and rare works full of passion, tragedy and love of life under the title “Tragoudi” – from songs to sirtaki.

title: Level Up Social Skills - youth club
description:
At the Level Up youth club we experiment, we grow and we can simply be ourselves.

You will strengthen your social skills, gain more security in everyday life and learn strategies that make many things easier.

Target group: young people on the neurodivergence spectrum between 10 and 15 years old.

title: Lu Jong - Tibetan healing yoga
description: The healing movements have their roots in Tibetan medicine. In this individual lesson we have the opportunity to get to know this wonderful practice and integrate it into our everyday lives in order to strengthen and bring balance to body and mind.

title: “Live at 11” with “Di klinna Zwei”
description:
Di klinna Zwei – these are the siblings Christel and Clemens Kaufmann, a duo who enjoy handmade, largely acoustic music.

Their repertoire spans Europe and combines folk traditions from different regions, klezmer melodies, Balkan rhythms, songs by Swiss songwriters and sounds from Salento. A musical mosaic is created.

Authentic and close to the audience, the two invite you to a varied, musical journey across borders.

The concert takes place in the old parish stables.
Duration: approx. 1 hour
Free collection

We look forward to your coming!
Balzers Cultural Commission

title: Tarkabarka traveling stage in Balzers
description:
Tarkabarka traveling stage in Balzers on the triangle near the community center

Humorous, surprising and touching - that is the company Tarkabarka from Liechtenstein. For 10 years, Anna and Bálint Kostyál-Büchel have been chugging through Switzerland, Liechtenstein, southern Germany, Austria and Hungary with their nostalgic circus wagon team. Her two children and her circus dog Buksi are always there.

The Tarkabarka company delights with expressive theater, fine clowning, fast acrobatics and poetic moments and lets children and adults alike forget time in front of the backdrop of the circus wagon. In her two pieces “KABUFF” and “HOPPAA!!” tell a lot - without words! Come in!

The performances last 60 minutes each and there is a hat collection at the end of the performances. More information at: www.tarkabarka.li
